cards.public_summary: Tee Higgins is limited this week with a heel issue, according to Bengals coach Zac Taylor.
cards.evidence: Bengals head coach Zac Taylor met the media before Tuesday's practice for the first time since they cut the roster to 53 players and said that wide receivers Ja'Marr Chase (knee) and Tee Higgins (heel) are limited this week.
cards.commentary: Higgins' practice limitation creates a short-term availability watch. The report gives no timetable or indication of whether he is in danger of missing the upcoming game; his next participation update is key.
cards.author: Geoff Hobson
